differences.text: The host is the separator (`role=separator`, `aria-orientation`, `aria-valuenow/min/max/valuetext`, `aria-label`, `aria-disabled`) through ElementInternals, with `tabindex=0` unless the author sets one. The value text is localised ("{size} px"). The non-drag alternative is the keyboard, plus `stepBy`, `stepToMin` and `stepToMax` methods that a button set can call.
The `resizable` object prop is a property (`resizable`) that takes a ResizableProps; the declarative wiring is the sibling panel or `for=<panel id>`. `no-always-visible` replaces `isAlwaysVisible`.
The pill placement (`start`, `end`) is logical and mirrors in RTL; upstream places it physically.

The pill grip is painted with --tecton-color-divider-strong (3:1 against the surface) while the divider line keeps --color-border. Pointer capture failures never throw, and the body cursor and user-select are restored on cancel and lost capture.
The percentage basis is direction aware: a viewport-based size measures the width for a horizontal handle and the height for a vertical one; a container basis is the observed content box.

core.resize-handle.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessibility] focusable separator with value semantics; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts base and pill; [mwg:css-layout] hit area larger than the visible line. Size: the budget (31 kB gzip) covers the bundled dependency closure (base class, controllers, locale catalogs), not the folder alone.
